name: BAM! File Sharing Web App
bullets: A web app that allows devices to share files by fist-bumping; files are sent peer-to-peer via WebTorrent
Designed and wrote the back-end architecture and the logic for connecting two clients and sending files
Worked with a team using Scrum and followed Scrum principles; was also the Product Owner
Built with React, Express, NodeJS, and MongoDB (MERN Full-Stack)
